title: Black SUVs, helicopters and a 30 ft hole near the crash site
summary: Brett Lanner tells of Black SUVs, helicopters and a 30 ft hole near the crash site, about 1999 at New Mexico (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: we found came across a hole and it was about 30 ft deep, 30 ft in diameter, kind of like a circular hole.

plain: A man named Brett Lanner tells a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about going in 1999 to Hart Canyon near Aztec, New Mexico, a place where a craft is said to have crashed long ago. He says there were black SUVs and helicopters around, and that they came across a round hole about 30 feet deep and 30 feet wide. If true, it would suggest someone was still digging at the site decades later.
